outcomes.deactivatedNeedsOwner_one: {{name}} was deactivated; {{count}} record needs a new owner — see Unassigned.
outcomes.deactivatedNeedsOwner_other: {{name}} was deactivated; {{count}} records need a new owner — see Unassigned.
outcomes.invitationResent: A new invitation link was sent to {{email}}.

changeRoleDialog.title: Change {{name}}’s role
changeRoleDialog.description: They are {{role}} today. A new role takes effect on their very next request — they do not need to sign out and back in.

deactivateMemberDialog.title: Deactivate {{name}}
deactivateMemberDialog.lastOwnerWarning: Transfer ownership before deactivating the last Owner.
deactivateMemberDialog.withOpenRecords: {{name}} owns {{summary}}. Reassign them now, or deactivate anyway and review them later in Unassigned.
deactivateMemberDialog.withoutOpenRecords: {{name}} will lose access immediately. They own no open deals or active orders.

inviteMemberDialog.title: Invite a member
inviteMemberDialog.description: They get an email with a link that is valid for 7 days. Nothing changes in this workspace until they accept it.
inviteMemberDialog.roleHint: Roles can be changed later from this list.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.description: Tokens let an outside system read and write this workspace through the public API. The workspace comes from the token itself — never from the URL.
apiTokens.newTokenNotice: Copy this token now — it is never shown again.
apiTokens.nameHint: What the token is for, e.g. "ERP sync".
apiTokens.scopesHint: A token can only do what its scopes allow — and never more than the person who issued it.
apiTokens.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty for a token that never expires on its own.
apiTokens.empty: No API tokens yet. Create one to let an outside system talk to this workspace.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this token?
revokeDialog.body: Any integration still using {{name}} stops working immediately. This cannot be undone — issue a new token instead.

revokeAllDialog.title: Revoke all API tokens?
revokeAllDialog.body_one: This revokes {{count}} API token immediately. Any integration still using it stops working. This cannot be undone — issue new tokens instead.
revokeAllDialog.body_other: This revokes {{count}} API tokens immediately. Any integration still using them stops working. This cannot be undone — issue new tokens instead.

billing.title: Billing & Subscription
billing.canceledBody: This workspace's Throughput subscription was canceled. Your data is kept for 30 days from cancellation and this workspace can be reactivated at any time during that window, with no re-onboarding.
billing.noActiveSubscription: No active Stripe subscription for this workspace.
billing.noPaymentMethod: No payment method on file yet.

accessBlocked.title: Workspace unavailable
accessBlocked.heading: This workspace is unavailable
accessBlocked.body: This workspace's Throughput subscription was canceled. Only an Owner can reactivate it — everything else, including your access, stays paused until then.
accessBlocked.askOwner: Ask an Owner to reactivate it:

dataExport.title: Export data
dataExport.description: A complete, machine-readable copy of everything this workspace holds — accounts, contacts, deals, orders, invoices, payments and the activity log.
dataExport.errorFallback: The export could not be started.
dataExport.progressMessage: Preparing your archive. This page updates on its own — you will also get an email when it is ready.
dataExport.retentionMessage_one: Download links stay valid for {{count}} day. After that the file is deleted and the request stays in this list.
dataExport.retentionMessage_other: Download links stay valid for {{count}} days. After that the file is deleted and the request stays in this list.
dataExport.empty: No data export has been requested for this workspace yet.

sentEmails.title: Sent emails
sentEmails.description: Every transactional email the public demo has tried to send — delivered to the allowlist, or intercepted (specs.md §22.3).
sentEmails.emailBodyEmpty: No body was captured for this email.
sentEmails.empty: No emails have been sent or intercepted yet.

shipping.title: Carrier settings
shipping.description: Choose the carrier this workspace uses to generate shipping labels, and its credentials.
shipping.apiKeyConfiguredHint: API key configured (ends in {{last}}). Leave blank to keep the current key.
shipping.apiKeyMissingHint: No API key configured yet. Sandbox key only (shippo_test_...) — never a live key, in any environment of this deployment.

webhooks.title: Webhook health
webhooks.description: Every Stripe event this deployment has received, with what happened to it (specs.md §12.3, §25.2).
webhooks.ignoredExplanation: Ignored is not an error. The Stripe sandbox is shared with another project, so events belonging to that project reach this endpoint with a perfectly valid signature. They are recorded and left alone — no workspace here maps to their customer. Only {{failedLabel}} needs attention.
webhooks.empty: No webhook events have been received yet.
